verdict.rationale: vLLM docs explicitly claim 'Efficient multi-LoRA support for dense and MoE layers' alongside quantization format support, directly matching the story of serving multiple LoRA adapters efficiently. However, this comes only from first-party docs with no independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically testing multi-LoRA serving. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of multi-LoRA serving performance, and detail on how adapters are dynamically loaded/switched at request time.
